title: YUE2 // GROOVE
description: Unofficial Gradio UI for YuE2: song generation and SheetSage2 Cover (dual venv + ffmpeg). Default SONG view. Model weights are CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial). Recommended: macOS Apple Silicon ≥32GB unified memory, or Linux NVIDIA ≥24GB VRAM (not enforced). Windows untested. Larger disk (YuE2 + SheetSage2; MERT may download on first Cover).
